A rare genetic mutation called pseudo-melanism has resulted in roughly half of the tigers in India's Similipal Tiger Reserve sporting coats with far more black than those of usual tigers. This widespread coloration is a symptom of a shallow gene pool in a region that previously faced a dwindling tiger population, and could prove catastrophic if conservation officers aren't able to find these tigers more genetically diverse mates. Sumatran tigers, native to the Indonesian island of Sumatra, are the smallest of the subspecies. Malayan tigers, native to the forests of the Malay Peninsula, have a slightly lighter coat that complements their surroundings. #tiger #sandiegozoo #sdzsafaripark

In just a few weeks, our 13-year-old Amur tiger, Morgana, will be leaving the Potawatomi Zoo and moving to another Association of Zoos and Aquariums-accredited zoo. Next time you visit the Zoo, stop by and say goodbye before she heads off to the next great chapter of her life. Morgana has been a beloved part of our Zoo family since 2015, when she arrived at the Zoo at the age of two. Although we will miss her, this move was recommended by the Amur Tiger Species Survival Plan. The SSP also recommended a pair of young tigers to move to the Zoo on a breeding recommendation.  In her new home, Morgana will have a great space to explore and lots of people to delight with her big personality. We know she’ll be loved in her new home as much as she was loved here!
